design_gotchas.title: CRITICAL: EN Pin Abs Max Is ONLY 8.0 V — NEVER Tie Directly to 12 V / 18 V VIN!
design_gotchas.detail: Although AP62200WU-7 accepts up to 18 V on VIN (20 V abs max), EN (Pin 5) has an 8.0 V absolute maximum rating! Tying EN directly to a 12 V bus (which works on pin-identical TPS563201DDCR) destroys AP62200WU-7. Leave EN floating to auto-enable or use a voltage divider keeping VEN < 6 V.

design_gotchas.title: Pin-Compatible With TPS54302DDCR & TPS563201DDCR — MISMATCH With AP63203WU-7 & Own SOT563 Sibling
design_gotchas.detail: AP62200WU-7 (TSOT26: 1=GND, 2=SW, 3=VIN, 4=FB, 5=EN, 6=BST) matches TPS54302DDCR and TPS563201DDCR, but is COMPLETELY incompatible with Diodes' own AP63203WU-7 (1=FB, 2=EN, 3=VIN, 4=GND, 5=SW, 6=BST) AND with AP62200Z6 (SOT563 swaps Pins 1/3 and 4/6).

design_gotchas.title: VREF = 0.800 V Differs From TPS563201 (0.768 V), TPS54302 (0.596 V) & AP62200T (0.763 V)
design_gotchas.detail: Replacing TPS54302DDCR (0.596 V) with AP62200WU-7 (0.800 V) without changing feedback resistors boosts VOUT by +34.2% (3.3 V jumps to 4.43 V!). Even against TPS563201DDCR (0.768 V), VOUT shifts +4.2%. Always recalculate resistors (or evaluate AP62200T at 0.763 V).

design_gotchas.title: 330 nF Bootstrap Capacitor Recommended for VOUT > 3 V (vs Standard 100 nF)
design_gotchas.detail: Section on Bootstrap Capacitor (p.18) recommends upsizing the BST-to-SW ceramic capacitor from 0.1 uF to 0.33 uF (330 nF) whenever VOUT > 3 V to ensure stable high-side gate drive in COT operation. Also verify 2 A continuous load limit vs 3 A TI peers.

typical_use_cases: 12 V consumer/industrial point-of-load buck (5 V, 3.3 V, 1.8 V, 1.2 V) up to 2 A with fast COT transient response
Cost-effective pin-compatible second-source candidate for 12 V <= 2 A TPS563201DDCR / TPS54302DDCR rails (after resistor & EN check)
Low-profile TSOT-23-6 distributed 5 V/12 V bus converter for routers, printers, white goods, and IoT hubs
engineering_summary: The AP62200WU-7 is a 4.2 V to 18 V input (20 V DC / 22 V transient abs max), 2 A continuous synchronous COT buck converter in TSOT-23-6 (TSOT26, RthetaJA = 70°C/W) operating at 750 kHz with 135 uA PFM Iq, 0.800 V +/-1% VREF, and ~94% peak efficiency (12 V -> 5 V). It shares the exact pinout of TPS54302DDCR and TPS563201DDCR (NOT AP63203WU-7), making it a strong 12 V / <= 2 A alternative only after adjusting feedback resistors for 0.800 V VREF, ensuring EN stays <= 8.0 V abs max (float to enable), and upgrading Cbst to 330 nF for VOUT > 3 V; verify the Diodes datasheet before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.1 confirmed TSOT26 (WU) Top View pinout (1=GND, 2=SW, 3=VIN, 4=FB, 5=EN, 6=BST), matching TPS54302DDCR/TPS563201DDCR and contrasting with SOT563 (Z6) and AP63203WU-7.
300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.2 Fig 2 confirmed peak efficiency ~94% at VIN = 12 V, VOUT = 5.0 V (~91% at 3.3 V).
300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.4 verified Abs Max VIN 20 V (22 V 400 ms), EN abs max 8.0 V, Rec Op VIN 4.2-18 V, TJ -40 to 125 C, RthetaJA 70 C/W (TSOT26), and RthetaJC(top) 42 C/W.
